what_differs: At the 6/17 kickoff Joyce asked to import all sign-up related data in Phase 1, and Kobi said data migration is included in this phase for the go-live objects. On 7/28 Waleed called historical data migration a go-live blocker. WAGR-470 (9/25) says the agreed scope mostly excludes historical sign-ups, and the title of WAGR-370 says that sign-up data was part of the agreed scope.
suggested_action: Check the SOW wording on data migration. Then change the WAGR-470 summary so that it states the kickoff position correctly, and record the decision with Joyce in writing (the 8/11 phased approach was only proposed, then parked). Before anyone tells the client that historical sign-ups are out of scope, review the client-optics risk.
